h:
Inpainting skin texture under the control of Controlnet tile and SegmentAnything, through a checkpoint of realistic skin texture.

Recommended to use the realistic texture checkpointepiCRealism - Natural Sin RC1 VAE | Stable Diffusion Checkpoint | Civitai

epiCRealism - Natural Sin RC1 VAE | Stable Diffusion Checkpoint | Civitai

The main model can use the SDXL checkpoint. This process is used instead of directly using the realistic texture lora because it achieves better and more controllable effects
